items.imageAlt: Two children in an old inventor's workshop watch a toy steam locomotive puff along a track, beside a brass phonograph, a glowing light bulb, a wind-up gadget and a metal cylinder.

Scene: A busy, sunny inventor's workshop in the early 1900s. A Grade 5 boy in goggles and a Grade 5 girl with braids admire inventions: a small toy steam locomotive chugging along a track and puffing steam, an old brass phonograph with a big flower-shaped horn, a glowing incandescent light bulb on the workbench, a little wind-up gadget, and a shiny metal cylinder. A sputtering kettle-like engine coughs a small puff of smoke in the corner.
